Landing PageVendor Growth ResponsiveB2B Marketing

Designed a vendor acquisition landing page to communicate FashionGo's value proposition and encourage brands to list and sell their products on the platform.

The page was designed mobile-first — over 60% of vendor research happened on phones. Each section was tested against one question: does this move a vendor closer to signing up?

Visual style matched FashionGo's buyer-facing brand while feeling premium enough to attract established fashion brands.

Sell on FashionGo — desktop

02 / 03   The Problem

150K buyers.
Vendors didn't
know.

FashionGo had a massive buyer network but struggled to convert fashion brands into active vendors. The existing onboarding page failed to communicate the platform's scale and differentiation.

Brands needed to understand: why FashionGo over other wholesale channels, what the actual reach was, and how easy it was to get started.

"We had the proof points — we just weren't presenting them in a way that made vendors feel the opportunity."

Mobile — vendor acquisition page

03 / 03   Outcome

Proof drives
sign-ups.

Restructuring the page around data credibility — not feature lists — increased vendor inquiry conversions. The payment terms section, once buried, became the most-engaged block.
